required_evidence: Protective action decision linked to source authority and timestamp
acceptance_test: decision log references PAD/PAR with exact time

required_evidence: EAS/WEA/SNB/press templates are current and loaded before exercise
All public-information links embedded in messages work at release time
All affected jurisdictions/municipalities are named or correctly scoped
KI wording consistent across message streams and reflects authority decision
acceptance_test: conflict diff returns zero critical mismatches

required_evidence: Farm/producer instructions align with evacuation, shelter, KI, food/milk/water controls
Message has accessible language, language access path, and non-digital fallback
Release order matches protective-action timing; no premature/inconsistent release
Rumor/misinformation correction path activated if conflict detected
Failed message, bad link, omission, or contradiction reopens packet
Internal sensitive detail suppressed while public meaning preserved
Evaluator observation linked to message packet
Any defect has CAP, retest, and verifier before closure
